articles.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
articles.snippet: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

articles.title: BTCPay restricts remote Lightning access after attackers steal funds
articles.snippet: Foundation and Citadel21 reported drained Lightning nodes, but the total amount stolen and number of affected operators remain unknown.

articles.title: Bitcoin Payment Service BTCPay Warns Critical Flaw Is Under Active Attack
articles.snippet: Bitcoin company BTCPay Server told users to install the latest version of the server and replace credentials that may have been exposed.

articles.title: Crypto Wrench Attacks on Pace for Record Year as $30M Stolen in 2026: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: The blockchain analytics firm says home invasions are becoming more common, France has emerged as the leading hotspot, and some attackers are using increasingly sophisticated laundering techniques.
